root_idea.summary: The root centers on low-growing, tender vegetation or herbs rather than enduring trees and shrubs.
root_idea.development: From the plant category, the lexical field extends to sprouting and emergence, land becoming green or producing vegetation, and the gathering, tending, or grazing of herbs.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun is presented under the normalized citation form بَقْل.

senses.definition: Tender plants or herbs whose root and branch do not persist through winter; low-growing vegetation rather than enduring trees or shrubs.
senses.usage_conditions: In بَقْلِهَا, the word is used collectively for the herbs or tender plants of the land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a boy's face, to put forth its beard or hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or transferred use describing the emergence of facial hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel's tush, to cut or come forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used specifically of the emergence of a camel's tooth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appear or become manifest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader transferred use derived from the emergence of vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect herbs for a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with herbs gathered as camel fodder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut or mow herbs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction بَقَلَ البَقْلَ denotes cutting the plants or herbage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave camels to pasture on herbs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative or transitive pastoral use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tend or care well for a beast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transferred use equated with caring for or managing an animal properly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land or a place, to produce herbs or vegetation; of shrubs or trees, to become green or put forth early shoots.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject may be land, a place, the ramth shrub, or trees; the use covers the appearance of green growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For people or a company, to find herbs or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of people encountering a place where herbs are present.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a boy's face put forth hair or a beard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative use applied to the growth of facial hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go forth seeking herbs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form V verb describes setting out in search of plants or herbage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an ass, livestock, or camels, to pasture on herbs and thereby become fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of animals feeding on بَقْل, with fattening presented as the resulting condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For people to have their cattle pasture on herbs, or to pasture their cattle on them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction in which people are associated with putting or keeping livestock at herb pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Green, immature crop or produce.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression بَاعَ الزَّرْعَ وَهُوَ بَقْلٌ, the crop is sold while still green and unripe.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In compounds naming particular plants, a specified herb such as purslane, endive, cabbage, celandine, fumitory, ivy or lablab, orache, sow-thistle, blite, balmgentle, or another regional herb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are lexicalized plant names; one recorded compound denotes a medicinal herb used for abdominal pains.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An epithet for land or a place that produces, contains, or is rich in herbs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Related forms such as بَقِيلَةٌ describe herb-producing land or a place of herbage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The herbs or plants produced in spring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This headword refers to spring growth as a class of plants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relating to herbs or plants of the بَقْل class.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective derived from the plural بُقُولٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of herbs or vegetables; by extension, a shopkeeper, grocer, or seller of dry provisions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The primary designation is a green-grocer; broader commercial uses are extensions of it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Green or newly emerging growth on a shrub or tree, especially the early shoots of the ramth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an epithet for the ramth when it greens or puts forth shoots, and for similar early growth appearing on trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bean or bean plant and its grain, especially the faba bean.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is recorded as a regional name in Iraq; an Egyptian plant designation is reported, but its exact botanical identification is uncertain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relating to beans or to the plant called بَاقِلَّى or بَاقِلَاء.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective formed from the bean names.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mug or cup without a handle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form بُوقَالٌ is also recorded for this vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A drinking vessel resembling a bowl or cup.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A vessel comparable to a طَاس or كَأْس.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Leaving camels to pasture on herbs.
Shrubs and trees becoming green or putting forth shoots.
Going out in search of herbs.
Animals grazing on herbs and becoming fat.
Core plant noun and green-crop use.
Regional Egyptian bean or plant designation.

cautions: The Egyptian botanical identification recorded under بَاقِلَّى / بَاقِلَاء is explicitly uncertain and is retained as a regional usage without resolving its species.
